title: GraceDB v2 Search Query
description: Structural JSON Schema for v2 search query trees. Enforces tree shape, operator names, and value types for the 'between', 'in', and 'is_null' operators. Semantic validation (valid fields per object type, valid operators per field, value ranges, label existence) is handled by the Python validator in gracedb/search/query/v2/validator.py.

node.description: Any query tree node: leaf comparison or AND/OR/NOT combinator.

leaf.description: A leaf node: a single field comparison. Requires 'field', 'op', and 'value'. The value type constraints below are structural; semantic constraints (e.g., valid operator for the field) are enforced by the Python validator.

field.description: Field name or recognized alias (e.g., 'far', 'si.snr', 'category'). Dot notation for attribute sub-table fields.

value.description: The comparison value. Type is constrained by op (see subschemas below) and further constrained by field type in the Python validator.

allOf.description: If op is 'between', value must be a 2-element array.
If op is 'in', value must be a non-empty array.
If op is 'is_null', value must be a boolean.
If op is a scalar comparison operator, value must be a scalar (string, number, or boolean).

and_node.description: AND combinator: matches objects satisfying all child conditions.

and.description: List of child nodes. All must be satisfied. Must contain at least one child.

or_node.description: OR combinator: matches objects satisfying at least one child condition.

or.description: List of child nodes. At least one must be satisfied. Must contain at least one child.

not_node.description: NOT combinator: inverts a single child condition.

not.description: The single child node to negate.

scalar_value.description: A scalar value for single-valued operators (=, !=, <, <=, >, >=, contains, startswith, has, not_has). May be a string, number, or boolean. Further type constraints (e.g., must be a number for FAR comparisons) are enforced by the Python validator.

between_value.description: A 2-element array [lo, hi] for the 'between' operator. Both elements must be the same type (both numbers or both strings). The constraint lo <= hi is enforced by the Python validator.

in_value.description: A non-empty array for the 'in' (set membership) operator. Elements must be strings or numbers. Homogeneity and field-type compatibility are enforced by the Python validator.

is_null_value.description: A boolean value for the 'is_null' operator. true = field IS NULL; false = field IS NOT NULL.
